ordering: timestamp, tx_hash, log_index; a deterministic micro-order is added within tied seconds so rolling frames never see later same-second fills
volatility: sqrt(sum(one-trade price_change^2)) over the backward window
trend_slope: OLS slope of p_yes on deterministic micro-time, reported per second
return_streak: consecutive non-zero one-trade return signs through the current economic fill
large_trade_threshold: TRAIN-only market q90 of size_shares with family TRAIN q90 fallback when market TRAIN count <100
activity_reference: TRAIN-only market median 60s trade_count with family TRAIN median fallback when market TRAIN count <100

context.family: rolling leave-target-out aggregates across other market updates in the same election family
context.event: rolling leave-target-out aggregates across other market updates sharing event_id
context.exclusion: subtract the complete target condition contribution mechanically from aggregate sums/counts
context.price_movement: mean one-trade canonical YES price change of non-target updates in the window
context.activity: number of non-target economic fills in the window
context.dispersion: population standard deviation of non-target one-trade price changes
context.fraction_up_down: fraction of non-target price-changing updates with positive/negative sign
context.note: These are causal update-weighted context measures. They do not require book coverage or carry forward a future trade.

clock_targets.selection: last subsequent economic fill at or before decision+h using a strictly-following deterministic frame
clock_targets.no_observation: NULL/NO_FUTURE_OBSERVATION when the frame contains no later economic fill
clock_targets.observed_stasis: zero change only when a later economic fill exists and has the same canonical price
clock_targets.realised_movement: sqrt(sum(one-trade price_change^2)) over subsequent fills inside the horizon

event_targets: LEAD by 1/2/5/10 economic fills in deterministic market order
split: family-wide synchronized 60/20/20 time-span boundaries; target-specific purge and 300s embargo are applied in screening/model stages
